content.text:
[tool.poetry]

name = "dcat-catalog-check"
version = "1.1.0"
description = "DCAT Catalog Check"
authors = [
  "Jesper Zedlitz <jesper.zedlitz@stk.landsh.de>",
  "Thorge Petersen <petersen@rz.uni-kiel.de>",
]
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
readme = "README.md"

[tool.poetry.dependencies]
python = "^3.10"
requests = "^2.32.3"
python-magic = "^0.4.27"
frictionless = {extras = ["wkt"], version = "^5.18.1"}
geopandas = "^1.0.1"
rdflib = "^7.1.1"
pypdf = "^5.1.0"
pillow = "^11.0.0"
fiona = "^1.10.1"
pyarrow = "^18.1.0"
geojson = "^3.2.0"
gdal = "3.6.2"

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
coverage = "^7.6.1"
ruff = "^0.6.8"

[build-system]
requires = ["poetry-core"]
build-backend = "poetry.core.masonry.api"
---RESOURCES---
total 12
drwxr-xr-x 2 root root 4096 Oct 18 17:07 .
drwxr-xr-x 8 root root 4096 Oct 18 17:30 ..
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 1854 Oct 18 17:07 file_types.json
{
  "7Z": [
    "application/x-7z-compressed"
  ],
  "ARCINFO_COV": [
    "application/zip"
  ],
  "ATOM": [
    "text/xml", "application/xml"
  ],
  "CSV": [
    "text/csv", "text/plain", "application/csv"
  ],
  "DOC": [
    "application/msword"
  ],
  "DWG": [
    "image/vnd.dwg"
  ],
  "GDB": [
    "application/zip"
  ],
  "GEOJSON": [
    "application/json"
  ],
  "GEOTIFF": [
    "image/tiff"
  ],
  "GML": [
    "text/xml", "application/xml"

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat pyproject.toml && echo "---RESOURCES---" && ls -la resources/ && head -30 resources/file_types.json
